title: The Professor and the Flea
summary: A clever balloonist and conjurer fell on hard times and was left with only a trained flea that could perform fencing drills and fire miniature brass cannons....
full_text:
A clever balloonist and conjurer fell on hard times and was left with only a trained flea that could perform fencing drills and fire miniature brass cannons.

Traveling to the land of the Cannibals, the professor and his flea performed before the savage king and queen, who were so enchanted that they refused to let them leave, keeping them in golden cages.

The professor used his wits: he built a giant hot-air balloon, told the king it was a royal chariot to view the heavens, climbed aboard with his flea, and sailed away to freedom!
moral: Ingenuity and presence of mind can turn even the smallest partner into an instrument of liberation.
